description: SMS review Phase-2 changes (plan items 2 & 3) in lib/presentation/screens/sms_review/sms_review_screen.dart and lib/presentation/providers/sms_review_providers.dart. Item 2 (SMS side): single-confirm opens the shared AddTransactionScreen pre-filled via SmsPrefill (from FEAT-001) and marks the SMS 'added' ONLY after a successful save. Item 3: a Detected-tab batch action 'Add all N' that directly creates transactions for every detected message with a confident bank->account match. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (SmsPrefill + AddTransactionScreen param + pop(context,true) contract).
steps: Read context.json, this file, and FEAT-001.json findings (for the exact SmsPrefill location/fields) FIRST, plus plan.md D2 and D3. Read sms_review_screen.dart and sms_review_providers.dart fully.

Refactor the bank->account match: lift the logic in _SmsCardState._match into a shared helper, e.g. top-level `AccountModel? smsBestMatchAccount(SmsReviewModel sms, List<AccountModel> accounts)` in sms_review_providers.dart (or a small util), and make _SmsCardState._match call it. This is behavior-preserving (same lowercase contains / reverse-contains logic). Both the single card and the batch action must use this one implementation.

Item 2 single-confirm: in _SmsCardState, replace the inline TransactionModel build in `_confirm` for the SINGLE path with opening the shared form: resolve the account (chosen via smsAccountChoiceProvider else smsBestMatchAccount else first), then `final saved = await AppRoutes.pushModal<bool>(context, AddTransactionScreen(smsPrefill: SmsPrefill(type: sms.isDebit ? 'expense' : 'income', amount: sms.amount, description: sms.merchant, paymentMethod: 'UPI', date: sms.date, accountId: account?.id, smsMessageId: sms.smsMessageId, externalReference: sms.referenceId)));`. Only when `saved == true`, call `ref.read(smsQueueProvider(widget.tab).notifier).updateStatus(sms.id, 'added')`. Keep the _busy double-tap guard and the 'add an account first' snackbar when no account exists. Do NOT fire the inline createTransaction in the single path anymore.

Item 3 batch: in _MessageList (tab == 'detected'), add an 'Add all N' action in the summary card area, where N = count of `items` whose `smsBestMatchAccount(item, accounts)` is non-null. If N == 0, hide/disable the action. On tap: guard re-entry with a processing flag held in a StateProvider<bool> (so taps during the run are ignored); for each confidently-matched detected message, build the SAME source:'sms' TransactionModel the old inline _confirm built (type by isDebit, amount, description = merchant ?? 'SMS Transaction', paymentMethod 'UPI', accountId = matched account, date, source 'sms', smsMessageId, externalReference = referenceId) and call createTransaction, then updateStatus(id,'added'). After the loop: one AppHaptics.success() and one snackbar 'Added N transactions'. Messages without a confident match remain 'detected'. Reload the queue once at the end. Undo is optional per plan (summary snackbar satisfies the minimum).
Keep all other SMS screen behavior (Scan/Paste, permission banner, Ignore, Move back to detected, View original message) unchanged.

Run dart format on both files; run flutter analyze and flutter test (incl. sms_parser_test, sms_dedupe_test); fix any issues. Stage ONLY sms_review_screen.dart and sms_review_providers.dart by name and commit locally (e.g. 'feat(sms): route single-confirm through add form + batch add-all'). Do not push. Record in findings any provider name added (e.g. the processing StateProvider) and the smsBestMatchAccount signature.
acceptance_criteria: Confirming a single detected SMS opens the prefilled AddTransactionScreen; on save the SMS becomes 'added'; on cancel/back it stays 'detected'.
The transaction created from an SMS carries source='sms', smsMessageId, and externalReference.

The Detected tab shows an 'Add all N' action; tapping it creates transactions only for messages with a confident unique account match, marks them 'added', fires one haptic and one summary snackbar, and leaves ambiguous messages 'detected'.
The batch action cannot double-run while processing.
`flutter analyze` clean; `flutter test` passes (incl. SMS tests).
findings: SHARED HELPER: top-level `AccountModel? smsBestMatchAccount(SmsReviewModel sms, List<AccountModel> accounts)` added to lib/presentation/providers/sms_review_providers.dart (needed a new `import '../../data/models/account_model.dart';` there). It is behaviour-preserving — identical lowercase contains / reverse-contains (name.length >= 3) logic lifted out of _SmsCardState._match, which now just delegates: `AccountModel? _match(List<AccountModel> accounts) => smsBestMatchAccount(sms, accounts);`. Both the single card and the batch action call this one implementation. NEW PROVIDER: `final smsBatchProcessingProvider = StateProvider<bool>((ref) => false);` in sms_review_providers.dart — true while the Detected-tab batch 'Add all' run is in flight; _addAll reads/sets it to ignore re-entrant taps and PrimaryButton binds its `loading:` to it. ITEM 2 (single-confirm): _SmsCardState._confirm no longer builds a TransactionModel; it resolves the account (smsAccountChoiceProvider override else smsBestMatchAccount else accounts.first — unchanged precedence in build()), keeps the no-account snackbar + _busy double-tap guard, then `final saved = await AppRoutes.pushModal<bool>(context, AddTransactionScreen(smsPrefill: SmsPrefill(type: isDebit?'expense':'income', amount, description: sms.merchant, paymentMethod: 'UPI', date: sms.date, accountId: account.id, smsMessageId, externalReference: sms.referenceId)));` and only calls `smsQueueProvider(widget.tab).notifier.updateStatus(sms.id,'added')` when `saved == true`. Cancel/back leaves it 'detected'. New imports in sms_review_screen.dart: `../../../core/navigation/app_routes.dart` and `../add_transaction/add_transaction_screen.dart`. ITEM 3 (batch): `_MessageList._addAll(BuildContext, WidgetRef, List<SmsReviewModel> matched, List<AccountModel> accounts)` builds the SAME source:'sms' TransactionModel the old inline _confirm built (description = sms.merchant ?? 'SMS Transaction'), calls transactionListProvider.notifier.createTransaction then smsRepositoryProvider.updateStatus(id,'added') per message, then one smsQueueProvider(tab).notifier.loadQueue(), one AppHaptics.success(), one snackbar 'Added N transactions.'. The Detected summary AppCard now holds a full-width PrimaryButton 'Add all N' (N = count of items with a non-null smsBestMatchAccount) shown only when N>0, with loading bound to smsBatchProcessingProvider. Ambiguous (unmatched) messages stay 'detected'. Batch builds transactions directly and never opens the form. VERIFIED: `flutter analyze` clean (0 issues) and `flutter test` all passed (incl. sms_parser_test, sms_dedupe_test); both touched files dart-formatted.
